sourceContract: Codex CLI hook JSON protocol (SubagentStop) reporting a delegated agent's own cumulative usage and completion status
author: otel-hook integration owner (agent)
sanitization: Subagent id and token counts are invented placeholders, not a measurement of any real delegation.
notes: Deliberately reports a smaller total (4800) than the parent session's running total at the same moment (22500), so a test can prove the subagent keeps its own baseline series and does not produce a spurious reset or a negative delta against the session curve.
